task.title: Apply the CI suite's anti-skip guards to the release workflow
task.description:
PR #28 built the machinery that stops a silently shrinking suite from reporting success, but applied none of it to .github/workflows/release.yml -- the pipeline that actually ships darwin/linux archives, and so the highest-consequence gate in the repo.

release.yml:39-40 is still:

    - name: Test
      run: go test ./...

with no actions/setup-node step, no WORKBOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_CAPABILITIES, and no pipe through scripts/skipreport. Compare .github/workflows/ci.yml, which provisions node, runs scripts/check-ci-capabilities.sh as a preflight, sets WORKBOOK_TEST_REQUIRE_CAPABILITIES=1 on the test step, and pipes 'go test ./... -json' through 'go run ./scripts/skipreport' under 'set -o pipefail'.

Consequence: a release can be cut and published with all 36 embedded-client tests in internal/webui/handler_test.go skipped and the job still green -- the precise failure mode the CI ticket was written to remove -- the moment the ubuntu-24.04 image stops preinstalling node. The same applies to the SHA-256 subtests that skip when git lacks --object-format support.

Fix: mirror ci.yml's Set up Node step, capability preflight, env var, and skipreport pipe into release.yml's Test step. Roughly one env var plus a preflight invocation; the supporting scripts already exist and are tested.

Deferred from PR #28 review: classified minor because it does not affect the push/pull-request CI the ticket asked for, and the release workflow's risk only materializes if the runner image drops node. Filed rather than fixed to keep that PR scoped to its major finding (the concurrency group that was cancelling push-to-main verification).
